Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libexif && grep -RIn "identify_variant (const unsigned char \*buf" libexif | sed -n '1,20p' && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"attacker input","code":"A crafted EXIF/JPEG file is supplied to the loader","note":"The attacker controls the raw bytes that will be parsed by libexif."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/exif-loader.c","function":"exif_loader_write","line":145,"var":"buf/len","code":"exif_loader_write(eld, buf, len)","note":"The loader accepts the attacker bytes and begins scanning them for EXIF metadata."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/exif-data.c","function":"interpret_maker_note","line":799,"var":"e = exif_data_get_entry(data, EXIF_TAG_MAKER_NOTE)","code":"MakerNote entry is fetched from parsed EXIF data","note":"If the image contains a MakerNote tag, its raw value is passed to MakerNote identification."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/olympus/exif-mnote-data-olympus.c","function":"exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify","line":622,"var":"e->data / e->size","code":"int variant = exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant(e->data, e->size);","note":"The identify routine inspects the MakerNote buffer to decide whether it is an Olympus/Nikon/Sanyo/Epson variant."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/olympus/exif-mnote-data-olympus.c","function":"exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant","line":588,"var":"buf_size","code":"if (buf_size >= 8) { ... }","note":"The function only checks the length before reading the first 8 bytes, so a short buffer can still reach later reads if the length is misclassified or insufficiently validated elsewhere."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/olympus/exif-mnote-data-olympus.c","function":"exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant","line":596,"var":"buf[6]","code":"else if (!memcmp (buf, \"Nikon\", 6)) { switch (buf[6]) { ... } }","note":"For Nikon MakerNotes, the code reads buf[6] to distinguish variants, which is the suspected out-of-bounds access when the MakerNote does not actually contain enough bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/exif-data.c","function":"interpret_maker_note","line":799,"var":"data->priv->md","code":"data->priv->md = exif_mnote_data_olympus_new (data->priv->mem);","note":"A successful identification routes execution into the Olympus MakerNote parser, making the unsafe read reachable during normal metadata parsing."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
